description: Sound sample sites for hunting clips. Each id must match candidateLinks.siteId in universe-character-hook-candidates.json. Rows marked review terms need your approval before relying on redistribution. Optional per-site discovery.soundPageUrlRegexes and discovery.htmlEmbeddedAudioRegexes are used by the candidates pipeline; when a site omits a list, manifests/sourcing-config.json discovery.*Regexes are used as fallback.

sites.name: BBC Sound Effects
sites.notes: Archive SFX; mostly non-dialogue; strict BBC reuse rules.

sites.name: CurseForge
sites.notes: Game mods and packs; per-project license.

sites.name: Freesound
sites.notes: Per-clip CC licenses; strong for short voice lines and SFX.

sites.name: GameBanana
sites.notes: Skins/mods including audio.

sites.name: Hanna-Barbera Sound Effects (Fandom)
sites.notes: Classic cartoon SFX reference pages.

sites.name: Internet Archive
sites.notes: Huge mix of uploads; copyright and quality vary—verify each item.

sites.name: itch.io game audio
sites.notes: Indie packs; creator license per page.

sites.name: Kenney
sites.notes: CC0 game assets; mostly non-dialogue SFX.

sites.name: Mixkit
sites.notes: Curated free SFX; check if dialogue clips fit your use case.

sites.name: ModDB
sites.notes: Mod bundles; verify author license.

sites.name: movie-sounds.org
sites.notes: Film quote pages; read site terms before download.

sites.name: Movie Sound Clips (.net)
sites.notes: Large movie/TV/game quote index (wav/mp3). Verify copyright and site terms for your use.

sites.name: Nexus Mods
sites.notes: Per-game mod permissions; franchise voice replacements sometimes.

sites.name: OpenGameArt
sites.notes: Community assets; often CC; verify per file.

sites.name: Pixabay SFX
sites.notes: License shown per asset; mix of SFX and occasional voice.

sites.name: Sonniss GDC giveaways
sites.notes: Professional SFX bundles; not franchise dialogue.

sites.name: The Sounds Resource
sites.notes: Game hubs → character asset pages; ZIPs with VO and SFX.

sites.name: Steam Workshop
sites.notes: Game-dependent audio mods; Workshop EULA applies.

sites.name: Voicy
sites.notes: Character-tagged clips; verify license per clip. Soundboard pages embed links to audio; fetch resolves src/href in HTML.

sites.name: Zapsplat
sites.notes: Large SFX library; account often required; check redistribution terms.
